svg.text: PROPOSED TARGET-STATE — event-day scale-out per SIMF-SAD-001 §A.3 (owner-approved sizing). Zone names / HA / host names / IP ranges / appliance vendors are illustrative and [OWNER / INFRA INPUT REQUIRED]. Current as-built deployment is a single reverse proxy — see §2.7.
SIMF — Event-Day Production Architecture · Ministry of Defense Private Cloud

Capacity target: ≈ 30,000 concurrent attendees at peak (≈ 50,000 registered × 0.6 peak-factor, SIMF-PTS-001), ≈ 40,000 design headroom · p95 SLOs met at CPU < 75% · live video offloaded to YouTube (not on SIMF servers)
SITE SSA Zone — application servers (Secure Service Area)
SITE HSA Zone — data (High Security Area)
SIMF uses e-mail OTP — no SMS / NAFATH.
client-direct playback — does NOT traverse SIMF
×N = instance count. N+1 = one spare node for HA.
Only SIMF.Api + the worker hold DB connections;
SIMF.Web and SIMF.ControlPanel reach data only
Reads scale on the readable secondaries + per-node
in-memory cache (§A.1); SignalR fans out via the
As-built today: single reverse proxy, no WAF / LB,
HA pair · OWASP WAF · L7 LB
served from cache; session affinity at the LB
interactive islands call the API tier (HTTPS 443)
8 vCPU / 32 GB per node · Windows Server 2022

serves the mobile app + website + Control Panel APIs

Enterprise + AG is the production event topology only.

last known-good published build retained for rollback.
